author: claude
statement: Theorem L of claude/lifting.md: g(c, q) is the infimum of the entropy production over finitely supported measures (nu, Q) on Omega = [-1,1]^2 x {-1,1} subject to stationarity, F1, F2 and the three scalar constraints, all linear; hence g(c, q) is a convex function of (c, q), vanishing exactly on the equilibrium region.
quote: g(c, q) is a convex function of (c, q)
